analyzed_vuln.description: `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` incorrectly assumes every atom query is an `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` and performs an unchecked `static_cast` from `atom->getQuery()` to `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY*` (line ~744). For crafted molecules, the actual dynamic type can be a composite query like `Queries::AndQuery<int,const Atom*,true>` (`"AtomAnd"`), so this downcast is invalid and triggers UB. The recursive helper `completeQueryAndChildren()` further propagates this assumption by C-style casting all children to `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY*` without type checks.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input is a Mol block parsed by `MolDataStreamToMol()` that causes `_NeedsQueryScan` to be set during property parsing (e.g., via query-related molfile properties such as `M  RBC ...`) and creates non-equality atom query trees (like `AtomAnd`). In `finishMolProcessing()`, when `_NeedsQueryScan` is present, it calls `QueryOps::completeMolQueries(res)`, which blindly downcasts and hits UBSan on the malformed/unsupported query type.
